title: Cohesity Instance
description: Everything about one cluster. Pick the cluster at the top.

targets.expr: label_replace(cohesity_up{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(count(cohesity_check_success{cluster="$cluster"} == 0) or vector(0), "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_cluster_nodes{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace((count(cohesity_node_in_cluster{cluster="$cluster"} == 0) or vector(0)) + (sum(cohesity_node_offline_disks{cluster="$cluster"}) or vector(0)), "k", "3", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_cluster_stopped_services{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "4", "", "") or label_replace(sum(cohesity_alerts_open{cluster="$cluster",severity="critical"}) or vector(0), "k", "5", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_time_offset_seconds{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "6", "", "") or label_replace(time() - cohesity_check_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster="$cluster",check="cluster"}, "k", "7", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Health
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Collected: Time since this cluster was last collected.

targets.expr: label_replace(100 * cohesity_storage_used_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} / cohesity_storage_capacity_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_storage_available_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_storage_available_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} / clamp_min(deriv(cohesity_storage_used_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}[30d:1h]), 1) / 86400, "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_cluster_data_reduction_ratio{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "3", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_storage_capacity_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "4", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_cluster_usable_capacity_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "5", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Capacity
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Days until full (30d trend): Available space divided by the 30-day growth rate. Shows a very large number while usage is flat or falling; needs several days of data to settle. Data reduction: Logical data in / physical data written (N:1). Usable after resiliency: Minimum usable capacity after erasure coding or replication factor.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, domain) (cohesity_storage_domain_bytes{cluster="$cluster",kind="data_in"}) / max by (cluster, domain) (cohesity_storage_domain_bytes{cluster="$cluster",kind="data_written"} > 0)

label_replace(count(cohesity_group_info{cluster="$cluster"}) or vector(0), "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(count(cohesity_group_last_run_ok{cluster="$cluster"} == 0) or vector(0), "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(sum(cohesity_group_last_run_sla_violated{cluster="$cluster"}) or vector(0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(sum(cohesity_group_paused{cluster="$cluster"}) or vector(0), "k", "3", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_runs_active{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "4", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_objects{cluster="$cluster",protected="no"}, "k", "5", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Protection
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Unprotected objects: Objects on registered sources that no protection group covers.

panels.title: Protection groups
panels.description: Status is the last backup run's (a running run shows running). The full run history is in the cluster UI.

panels.title: Failed objects (last run of failed or warned groups)
panels.description: Capped at 200 objects across 20 groups per collector run. Get-CohesityFailedObjects.ps1 lists them all as CSV.

panels.title: Runs started in the last 24 hours, by status
New alerts per hour by severity
Open critical and warning alerts
panels.description: The 20 newest open critical and warning alerts. Every new alert, info included, is archived daily under events\ on the monitoring host.

targets.expr: label_replace(cohesity_collector_info, "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_collector_last_run_timestamp_seconds * 1000, "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(count(cohesity_check_success{cluster="$cluster"} == 0) or vector(0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(cohesity_collect_duration_seconds{cluster="$cluster"}, "k", "3", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Collector
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Package version: Version of the installed Cohesity monitoring package (VERSION file in the install folder).
